# Waller V1.0.9.1

## Improvements
- Faster Image Progressing in successions by threading and a lazy import mechanism for android classes
- Capturing Images from Android `Allow Limited Access` File picker on Android 14+
- Hiding navigation and status bars when on wallpaper preview screen on Android 11+

## Fixes
- Capping Logs file by size to prevent overflow and allow faster processing
- Light Mode color for inactive tabs
- Unified Git Flow For APK Debug and Release
- Interrupting Button Animation when closing bottom sheet is guarded by kivymd
- Avoided Fbo Error with BottomNavigationBar
